links.comparator_used: Autonomous ChatGPT (and a paper guide) in a simulated CPR scenario with lay participants
links.outcome: Decision accuracy, cognitive load (LF/HF ratio), trust in AI, and scenario completion time
links.effect: Supervised-ChatGPT showed significantly higher decision accuracy than the paper guide and ChatGPT groups. It had a reduced LF/HF ratio, suggesting potentially lower cognitive load, and the highest trust in AI. No numeric values were reported in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Scenario completion time was longer with supervision. In one instance autonomous ChatGPT suggested a risky option, which shows why clinician supervision is needed.
links.quote: Results indicate that the Supervised-ChatGPT group showed significantly higher decision accuracy compared to the paper guide and ChatGPT groups, although the scenario completion time was longer.
